summary: text limits the rule to 1997-02-28; last change to the provision took effect 1997-01-22

summary: text limits the rule to 1997-02-28; last change to the provision took effect 1997-01-22

summary: text limits the rule to 1994-12-31; last change to the provision took effect 1991-07-04

summary: text limits the rule to 1994-09-01; last change to the provision took effect 1991-07-04

summary: text limits the rule to 2021-12-31; last change to the provision took effect 2020-04-15

summary: text limits the rule to 2026-06-30; last change to the provision took effect 2026-06-26

summary: text limits the rule to 1998-12-20; last change to the provision took effect 1998-08-06

summary: text limits the rule to 1958-12-31; last change to the provision took effect 2014-10-31
review_note: 31 December 1958 closes the Convention’s signature window, not its operation or enforcement regime. Reproducing that historical treaty provision in a 2014 Act does not create a lapsed domestic rule.

summary: text limits the rule to 1961-10-31; last change to the provision took effect 2007-11-30
review_note: The date is a historical deadline for signing the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, not an expiry of diplomatic privileges. A later corpus update does not reactivate or extend that signature window.

summary: text limits the rule to 1962-03-31; last change to the provision took effect 2007-11-30
review_note: 31 March 1962 closes the Convention’s signature window, not the operation of diplomatic privileges or the incorporating Act. Reproducing that historical deadline in a later statutory compilation creates no lapse.

summary: text limits the rule to 1962-01-19; last change to the provision took effect 1967-01-01
